adjudication.rationale: The finding identifies a real issue in the loading.html.erb view. Looking at the diff, the loading page (lines 1-12 of app/views/embed/loading.html.erb) sets up a 30-second auto-reload with no termination condition. When embed#best cannot find a topic_id, it enqueues a RetrieveTopic job and renders 'loading'. If the retrieval permanently fails (e.g., invalid URL, unreachable host, parsing error), the page will keep reloading every 30 seconds indefinitely, continuously enqueuing new jobs. The TopicRetriever has throttling (60 seconds) but no permanent failure tracking. This creates an infinite loop scenario for permanently failing URLs.
